name: Saezz Skyborn
description: Saezz Skyborn (LE) leads the Crimson Judgment, inspiring respect and fear with his booming, commanding voice. His cruelty has stirred controversy among the Orders, yet his efficiency remains undisputed. He bears the burden of his family’s death to the Evolutionist Inquisition. This tragedy fuels his opposition to any talks with the Church, constantly reminding everyone of his people’s long-suffering under the Inquisition. While others ally with the reformed Celestianists, Saezz stands apart, suspecting corruption and considering other Cirrus Orders too lenient. His rigorous recruitment methods, bordering on torture, are born from his belief that true character is revealed under duress. Nevertheless, he fiercely protects his followers, being careful with Hizzas’ fanatism, as it can be inspiring but dangerous. Hizzas Skyborn (LE) is the other soul, alternating with Saezz each time they sleep. He is an obsessive Zafara devotee, seeing her as the god’s chosen. Hizzas has amassed Zafara’s ancient manuscripts and seeks to force his interpretation and doctrine on all. Hizzas talks with whispery, honeyed words, manipulating others into adopting his zeal. He believes he has found a prophecy in Zafara’s manuscripts and does anything necessary to make it true, believing it foretells the angels’ return to Tanares. He sees Saezz as a pivotal hero in this but thinks he must embrace Zafarism. Disturbed by reports of Zafara’s recent disappearance, he is sending knights and hiring adventurers to investigate the three prime suspects: the Cult of Shadow Wing.
